raw.title: Dinosaurs and Their Adaptations
raw.subject: Science
raw.learningObjective: Pupils will understand how dinosaurs adapted to their environments.
successCriteria: Pupils can explain how a specific dinosaur's features helped it survive in its habitat.
Pupils can identify different adaptations of dinosaurs.

learningMap.knowledge: Spinosaurus lived in what is now North Africa’s Sahara region, which then had a large river system.
Spinosaurus was well adapted for aquatic life.
Spinosaurus had nostrils further up on its snout than other dinosaurs.
Spinosaurus's nostrils further up let it breathe with most of its snout underwater.
Spinosaurus's webbed feet allowed the dinosaur to swim.
Brachiosaurus had forelegs longer than its hind legs.
Brachiosaurus's longer forelegs helped it reach high into the trees.

raw.teachingApproach: Use engaging visuals of dinosaurs and their habitats to illustrate adaptations. Discuss real-life examples of how specific features help animals survive in their environments.
